newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo to mint new gold, silver coins - news agency.
newsitem.headline: Yugo to mint new gold, silver coins - news agency.

text.p: The Yugoslav government decided at its session Friday to mint new gold and silver coins marking the 140th anniversary of the birth of Serb scientist Nikola Tesla, the Yugoslav state news agency Tanjug said.
The 1,000-dinar gold and 300- and 200-dinar silver coins will be on sale from mid-October, the federal information ministry said in a statement carried by Tanjug.
The government also said the central bank would re-mint 10,000 20-dinar metal coins from coins now in circulation.
